name: copilotprompts-skill-dataverse-blueprint
title: Dataverse Blueprint — Data Model as Code
shortDescription: A GitHub Copilot skill with a bundled CLI that designs, validates (30 rules + score), documents, deploys, audits and drift-checks Microsoft Dataverse data models as code, with pull-request reviews via SARIF.
longDescription: Dataverse Blueprint treats a Microsoft Dataverse data model as code. GitHub Copilot turns a business process into a reviewable blueprint.yaml; a bundled zero-dependency Python CLI validates it against 30 architecture rules (ownership, date behavior, cascade, alternate keys, PII column security, Append/AppendTo, least-privilege depth) with a score, renders the design document with a Mermaid ER diagram and security matrix, compiles an ordered and idempotent Dataverse Web API deployment plan that lands every component inside a solution, deploys it to a development environment, exports existing environments back to blueprints for audits, and diffs repository vs. environment to detect drift. Includes a GitHub Actions workflow that reviews model changes in pull requests with SARIF annotations. Works in English and Spanish.
